name: team_planning_planners
description: List who may create Team Planning plans: the planners an admin chose, and the tenant's admins, who always may. Each with a person id and name. Each planner also has since (the date it took effect; for one already_held, the date Espalia recorded it), added_by (who made them one, or null when no one did) and already_held (true when they were a planner before Espalia recorded who gave it). Admins only.
